title: HR24 modular library boundary + navigation shell R2
purpose: Enforce durable Library/Application Shell/Learning Loop V2/Atlas boundaries, repair mobile inline rename, and add a scalable accessible left navigation drawer without changing pedagogical semantics.
invariants: Library operations do not mutate pedagogical state.
Atlas integration does not own or rewrite private Library DOM.
Learning Loop V2 and Atlas core semantic modules remain byte-identical to the parent.
HR24-003 remains READ_ONLY and is not repaired in this job.
No merge, promotion, GO_LIMITED_PILOT, G5 PASS or student session.
nonGoals: Repairing HR24-003 or adding scheduler/reserving semantics.
Changing scoring, ActivityResponse, objective states, recommendations, sessionDelta or V5 authored content.
Inventing collections, shelves, subjects or chapters.

A.evidence: core/library.js parent is manifest-backed blob d94dcb05b5afbb83bd957a942565001f9bd74bf2; deterministic build supports git cat-file materialization; WP067 materializes and rebinds it.

B.evidence: Removed Library->progress constructor dependency and Atlas integration->private Library DOM mutation.

C.evidence: Library query/command service; read-only learning projection port; shell semantic events; shell-owned navigation state.

D.evidence: IndexedDB v3 adds libraryMetadata and migrates aliases additively; rename writes no courses/progress/objectiveProgress record.

E.evidence: Learn-it / Aujourd’hui / Bibliothèque / Tous les cours / Importer un cours only.

F.evidence: HR24-003 remains truthful UI plus unchanged protected engine semantics; separate engine job required.
